registered: 2026-10-07, before any computation (owner go via the Test Lead: 'go motor redesign. Make the design interface as useful as we can to more score=value')
scope: public generator draws and public references only; never exam material. DEVELOPMENT.

interface.name: carbon.design_tasks (Challenge-neutral; motor first, battery and cooling to adopt)

task.conditions: the operating points the design must satisfy
task.design_space: a finite candidate set (designs as input dicts)
task.objective: a physical quantity, sense and unit, aggregated over conditions (worst or mean)
task.constraints: hard limits on physical quantities, every condition

interface.optimizer: fixed and registered: exhaustive over the candidate set on the model's predictions; feasible only if every constraint holds at every condition; best objective, ties by the secondary then candidate id; abstain if none is predicted feasible
interface.judge: reference truth per (candidate, condition); outcome kind as quiz.q3 (SELECTED_FEASIBLE, SELECTED_INFEASIBLE, MISSED_OPPORTUNITY, CORRECT_ABSTENTION); regret in the objective's physical units against the best reference-feasible candidate; an infeasible pick is a false-feasible and carries no physical regret (reported separately)

motor_tasks.conditions: study V2's six recorded conditions (r01-r04 REPRESENTATIVE, b01-b02 BOUNDARY_STRESS)

objectives.basis: the owner's example; reported beside MOTOR-RIPPLE

screening.draw: valid geometries uniform over carbon.motor.domain.INPUT_BOUNDS (geometry inputs), numpy PCG64 seeded with sha256('MOTOR-SCREEN-V1')[:8]
screening.split: 15 uniform; 15 from 2000 uniform draws, those the public learned-krr-v1 model predicts nearest a limit (min over conditions of |mean - 4.0|/0.4 and |ripple fraction - 0.30|/0.03)
screening.runner: scripts/dev/motor/reference/run_batch.py in the pinned image ghcr.io/carbonphysicsai/carbon-motor-reference (main-75330721, sha256:599521e7...), 2 CPUs per case, operator host CPU, no spend

repeatability.cases: the 20 public TRAIN/PRACTICE cases nearest a limit (same distance as above, on the reference)
repeatability.band: per quantity, the largest |refined - standard| shift (battery's band basis); reported as a measured candidate to replace the 10 % HUMAN_INPUT recommendation

strata.near_limit: tasks whose 8 candidates include at least 2 within the near band of a limit at some condition (from the screened grids)
strata.typical_use: tasks whose 8 candidates are drawn from P(x): valid geometries uniform over INPUT_BOUNDS (the registered population)
strata.combination: HUMAN_INPUT weight; recommended 0.5/0.5; both strata and the combination reported

known_bad: edge_optimist (near-band: mean +0.5 N m, ripple x 0.8)
power.known_good: oracle and 9 noisy oracles (stand-in, sigma 3 % mean, 10 % ripple); analytic-v1 and learned-krr-v1 reported
power.metric: AUC of decision false-feasible (safety) and of physical regret (value), mean and p05 over 1000 draws, seed 20261007

value_check: Kendall tau-b and Spearman rho between members' design-task regret and their study-V2 decision regret (the full decision value)
cost: per task 8 x 6 = 48 GetDP solves; AX42 (16 threads, 8 concurrent) wall per batch reported

amendment_1.screening_draw: carbon.motor.population.public_rng('MOTOR-SCREEN-V1') and population.draw (the DEVELOPMENT population, Q = P): 15 uniform geometries, then 2000 for the near-limit pre-screen; the six geometry inputs kept, the conditions set from study V2 (replaces the numpy PCG64 wording)
amendment_1.repeatability_reason: full 15 degree period at the standard 60 angles, so the periodicity check holds and the derived mean and pk-pk compare like for like with the committed standard references; the motor-pilot-v1 options (angle_steps 120, positions 31) cover only a 3.75 degree window. Angle-sampling error on the ripple peak is not measured by this study and is reported as such.

amendment_2.registered: 2026-10-07, after the screen launch and before any screen result (Test Lead relay)
amendment_2.limits: 4.0 N m and 0.30 are TRAIN medians, not a customer specification; the owner may replace them with a mock-customer specification. Every limit-dependent output takes the limits and bands as arguments and is recomputed from the continuous points with no new solve
amendment_2.continuous_outputs: per point: the 60-angle torque curve (record), and GetDP's per-step coil vector potential (flux linkage) and co-energy kept in the case directories (meshes trimmed); mean torque, ripple pk-pk and ripple fraction in the study's points table. GetDP here is magnetostatic: no loss or thermal quantity is computed
amendment_2.limit_sweep: feasible designs and near points over min torque 1.0..8.0 N m (0.5 steps) x max ripple fraction 0.05..0.60 (0.05 steps), bands 10 % of each limit
amendment_2.deferred: Q3 (design-task) scenario selection is not finalised until the limits are confirmed; power and value results under the provisional limits are reported as provisional
amendment_2.rerun: the screen batch restarted with --keep all at 11:4x (the first launch discarded the coil and co-energy files); no result was read from the first launch
